section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study validating the Dutch translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) among 310 Dutch-speaking female university students (mean age 21.31). The study found a one-dimensional factor structure, good internal consistency, and convergent validity for the Dutch BAS-2. It also reported that lower BMI was associated with higher BAS-2 scores, supporting the cross-cultural equivalence of the instrument.
